title: Portal Anchor
description: Keeps portal-traveling mobs alive long enough to stop far-away dimension despawns from breaking portal farms.
body:
# Portal Anchor

Portal Anchor fixes a niche but painful vanilla server issue: mobs can disappear after going through a Nether portal if they arrive in a dimension where players exist, but are very far away.

That can break portal-based farms, especially setups that move mobs between the Overworld and the Nether.

This mod gives mobs a short grace window after dimension travel so they do not instantly despawn just because the nearest player is far away.

## Good to know

- Works server-side.
- Players do not need to install it on their client.
- Also works in singleplayer.
- Intended for portal farms and technical survival servers.
- Does not add blocks, items, mobs, or worldgen.

## Commands

Operators can check and tune the mod in-game:

```text
/portalanchor status
/portalanchor enabled <true|false>
/portalanchor grace <seconds>
/portalanchor save
/portalanchor reload
/portalanchor reset-stats
```
